_meta.description: EVAL-1 golden set: real, objectively-resolved binary (YES/NO) questions from 2024-2026 used to score whether pipeline changes make FORECASTS better (not just tests green). Each entry is a genuinely resolved, checkable event. 'resolved_outcome' is the ground-truth YES(true)/NO(false). 'as_of_date' is the date the forecast is made: backtest mode (docs/handoff/backtest/design.md) cuts every pipeline input there and backend/scripts/backtest_eval.py runs and scores the set. 'knowledge_cutoff' is the first date the outcome was public (for every current entry its resolution date: each outcome was reported the day it happened); a model whose training data reaches that date may already know the answer, so the scorer reports questions whose knowledge_cutoff falls after the model's training cutoff (pass --model-knowledge-cutoff) apart from the rest.
_meta.outcome_semantics: resolved_outcome=true  → the event described by 'question' HAPPENED (YES). resolved_outcome=false → it did NOT happen (NO). A forecast's 'probability' is the model's YES probability in [0,1].

questions.question: Will Donald Trump win the 2024 US presidential election?
questions.resolution_criteria: YES if Donald Trump is certified as winner with >=270 electoral votes per the official 2024 Electoral College result.

questions.question: Will Kamala Harris win the 2024 US presidential election?
questions.resolution_criteria: YES if Kamala Harris is certified as winner with >=270 electoral votes per the official 2024 Electoral College result.

questions.question: Will Republicans win a majority of seats in the US Senate in the 2024 election?
questions.resolution_criteria: YES if the Republican caucus holds >=51 Senate seats after the 2024 general election (they won 53).

questions.question: Will Democrats retain control of the US Senate after the 2024 election?
questions.resolution_criteria: YES if the Democratic caucus holds >=50 seats (with VP tiebreak) after the 2024 election. They lost the majority.

questions.question: Will the Labour Party win the most seats in the 2024 UK general election?
questions.resolution_criteria: YES if Labour wins a plurality of House of Commons seats in the July 2024 UK general election (won 411).

questions.question: Will the Conservative Party win the most seats in the 2024 UK general election?
questions.resolution_criteria: YES if the Conservatives win a plurality of House of Commons seats in July 2024. They finished second with 121.

questions.question: Will the National Rally (RN) win an absolute majority in the 2024 French National Assembly election?
questions.resolution_criteria: YES if RN and allies win >=289 of 577 seats in the July 2024 snap legislative election. They finished third; no absolute majority.

questions.question: Will Claudia Sheinbaum win the 2024 Mexican presidential election?
questions.resolution_criteria: YES if Claudia Sheinbaum wins the June 2, 2024 Mexican presidential election per the official INE count.

questions.question: Will Prabowo Subianto win the 2024 Indonesian presidential election?
questions.resolution_criteria: YES if Prabowo Subianto wins the February 2024 Indonesian presidential election outright in the first round (>50%).

questions.question: Will the BJP win an outright majority (272+ seats) on its own in the 2024 Indian Lok Sabha election?
questions.resolution_criteria: YES if the BJP alone wins >=272 of 543 Lok Sabha seats. It won 240 and needed NDA allies for a majority.

questions.question: Will the BJP-led NDA coalition win a majority in the 2024 Indian general election?
questions.resolution_criteria: YES if the NDA coalition wins >=272 of 543 Lok Sabha seats (won ~293).

questions.question: Will the Federal Reserve cut its policy rate at the September 2024 FOMC meeting?
questions.resolution_criteria: YES if the FOMC lowers the federal funds target range at its September 17-18, 2024 meeting (cut 50bps).

questions.question: Will the Federal Reserve cut its policy rate at the November 2024 FOMC meeting?
questions.resolution_criteria: YES if the FOMC lowers the federal funds target range at its November 6-7, 2024 meeting (cut 25bps).

questions.question: Will the Federal Reserve cut its policy rate at the December 2024 FOMC meeting?
questions.resolution_criteria: YES if the FOMC lowers the federal funds target range at its December 17-18, 2024 meeting (cut 25bps).

questions.question: Will the Federal Reserve cut its policy rate at the January 2025 FOMC meeting?
questions.resolution_criteria: YES if the FOMC lowers the federal funds target range at its January 28-29, 2025 meeting. It held rates steady.

questions.question: Will Apple announce the iPhone 16 lineup in September 2024?
questions.resolution_criteria: YES if Apple officially unveils the iPhone 16 family at an event during September 2024 (announced Sept 9, 2024).

questions.question: Will OpenAI publicly release a GPT-4o model in 2024?
questions.resolution_criteria: YES if OpenAI announces and makes available a model branded 'GPT-4o' during 2024 (announced May 13, 2024).

questions.question: Will Apple begin selling the Vision Pro in the US in early 2024?
questions.resolution_criteria: YES if the Apple Vision Pro goes on sale to US consumers in Q1 2024 (launched Feb 2, 2024).

questions.question: Will Nvidia's market capitalization exceed $3 trillion at any point in 2024?
questions.resolution_criteria: YES if Nvidia's market cap closes above $3T on any trading day in 2024 (first crossed June 2024).

questions.question: Will SpaceX catch a Starship Super Heavy booster with the launch-tower arms in 2024?
questions.resolution_criteria: YES if SpaceX successfully catches a returning Super Heavy booster with the tower 'chopsticks' during 2024 (achieved Flight 5, Oct 13, 2024).

questions.question: Will Bitcoin trade above $100,000 at any point in 2024?
questions.resolution_criteria: YES if BTC/USD prints above $100,000 on a major exchange during 2024 (first crossed early December 2024).

questions.question: Will the US SEC approve spot Bitcoin ETFs in January 2024?
questions.resolution_criteria: YES if the SEC approves spot Bitcoin exchange-traded products in January 2024 (approved Jan 10, 2024).

questions.question: Will Donald Trump be convicted on any count in the New York hush-money criminal trial in 2024?
questions.resolution_criteria: YES if the New York jury returns a guilty verdict on >=1 count against Trump in 2024 (convicted on 34 counts, May 30, 2024).

questions.question: Will Real Madrid win the 2023-24 UEFA Champions League?
questions.resolution_criteria: YES if Real Madrid wins the June 1, 2024 Champions League final (beat Borussia Dortmund 2-0).

questions.question: Will the Kansas City Chiefs win Super Bowl LVIII in February 2024?
questions.resolution_criteria: YES if the Chiefs win Super Bowl LVIII on Feb 11, 2024 (beat the 49ers 25-22 in OT).

questions.question: Will the Philadelphia Eagles win Super Bowl LIX in February 2025?
questions.resolution_criteria: YES if the Eagles win Super Bowl LIX on Feb 9, 2025 (beat the Chiefs 40-22).

questions.question: Will the Los Angeles Dodgers win the 2024 World Series?
questions.resolution_criteria: YES if the Dodgers win the 2024 World Series (beat the Yankees 4-1, clinched Oct 30, 2024).

questions.question: Will Spain win UEFA Euro 2024?
questions.resolution_criteria: YES if Spain wins the Euro 2024 final on July 14, 2024 (beat England 2-1).

questions.question: Will the Boston Celtics win the 2024 NBA Finals?
questions.resolution_criteria: YES if the Celtics win the 2024 NBA Finals (beat the Mavericks 4-1, clinched June 17, 2024).

questions.question: Will Oppenheimer win Best Picture at the 2024 (96th) Academy Awards?
questions.resolution_criteria: YES if Oppenheimer wins the Best Picture Oscar at the March 10, 2024 ceremony.
